Develop and maintain MS Dynamics 365 applications based on business requirements.
Configure and customize CRM solutions.
Implement and troubleshoot integrations with other systems including workflows and web services.
Implement and maintain access control based on roles and security best practices.
Collaborate within an Agile/Scrum team.
Define use cases and gather business requirements.
Effectively articulate potential solutions, ideas, and suggestions clearly.

Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise implementing and customizing Power Platforms and Dynamics 365 Cloud solutions, with a strong emphasis on Customer Service, Case Management, and Field Service.

Advanced knowledge of all phases of the SDLC, including processes and best practices.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a relevant discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Strong command of data migrations, third-party integrations (APIs/SSIS), plug-ins, automated CI/CD pipelines, and version management.
Proven ability to evaluate, design, and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 business solutions.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Solid understanding of Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, and SharePoint.
Microsoft CRM Application certification.
Demonstrated ability to translate technical information into clear business concepts.
Strong ability to present persuasively and effectively to varied audiences.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Ability to work autonomously and think creatively.
Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative working style.
